method: Run baseline and positive NLI; only on disagreement, run unchanged NLI on a deterministic whole-proposition negation. Override baseline only when positive and polarity-flipped negative agree.
negation: It is not the case that the following statement holds: <JSON-quoted original claim>
probe: 9 independent synthetic propositions, each tested in original and negated form; exact expected label reversal is required before development calls.
scout: Reuse all 42 V7 scout baseline/positive predictions and add only the necessary negative calls.
confirmation: New complete development groups, excluding every historical pilot, V5 fresh and V7 group; same-batch baseline and positive NLI; no policy adaptation from partial results.
acceptance: Both dataset accuracies and macro F1 must be nondecreasing, with a strict accuracy gain on at least one dataset; no statistically significant group-paired loss in any class recall. Report all observed losses, intervals, sample sizes and cost. Failure to detect a loss is not proof of noninferiority.
nontriviality: Returning the unchanged baseline on every example is a diagnostic outcome, not successful improvement.
data_policy: Only development claim/evidence and their deterministic negation enter the API. No gold, metadata, other model answers or test data. All files remain in the repository.
quota_policy: Reuse the existing provider-enforced free account and shared ledger; never change plan, endpoint or account. Preserve partial records on long quota reset.
